_doc: Every third-party host thelanguagepage.com may contact, read by tools/validate-language-page-network.mjs. Each entry needs host, purpose, dataSent, retention, and the privacy page (access-practice-lab/src/views/privacy.js) must name the host. The list is EMPTY on purpose: Joel decided on 2026-11-24 (data/product-decisions.json lp-no-third-party-analytics) that the lab host loads no third-party analytics. Fonts are self-hosted. Add a host here only after he approves it, and update the privacy page in the same commit.
